note: The text messages of cô Nga in the Messages app (plan 0003, R24, R25). A message comes once. "at" is a time (minutes after midnight) on each day, or on "day" only. "before" stops a message with "at" when the time is later. "after" is an event: "start" (a new game), "wake" (a new morning), "heard:LINE" (the player heard the line), or "lens:LINE" (the Lens app showed the description). "unless_card" stops the message when the player knows the card. "repeat": true lets the message come again each day.

messages.text: Chào con! Welcome to Vũng Tàu. I'm Nga, from the family at the homestay. You're staying with us in Hẻm 42, a short walk from Bãi Trước. It's 6 in the morning, and the hẻm is already busy. Walk around, eat, and fill your sổ tay (notebook) with what you learn.
A tip: tap the street to walk, or tap a shop to go there. Point the Lens app at a place, and it tells you what it is. Turn on Listen, and it writes down what people say, in Vietnamese and English.
“Ăn sáng chưa?” is a greeting. Bà Tư is saying good morning, and she's also telling you where to eat.
Bà Tư says you speak Vietnamese well! “Ăn sáng chưa?” is a greeting. She's saying good morning, and she's also telling you where to eat.
“Ăn sáng chưa?” is how neighbors say hi in the morning. Try “Dạ, chưa” (not yet) next time.
Bãi Trước is at the end of the hẻm. Early morning is the time to go: the boats are in.
Cô Sáu's phở is two doors from the homestay. Go before it sells out!
Phở is a morning food here. Most bowls are sold by 10 or 11. Come back early tomorrow.
Phở is a morning food here. Come back early tomorrow.
It's late, con. The hẻm is quiet and the shutters are down. Come home and sleep. Open the Clock app at the homestay.
Ngày {day}. Good morning! At {time} the hẻm is already awake: a broom on the concrete, a scooter warming up, sea wind, and the smell of broth from Cô Sáu's.
